title: Weekly KPI check-in + OKR draft
body:
Week of Mar 16 — quick personal KPI / OKR scratchpad

Purpose: capture progress, blockers, quick metric snapshot, and draft OKR wording to bring to 1:1 on Wed. Rough notes, not polished.

Current focus (Q2): reduce p99 latency for small-chat workload; increase cached-prefix hit rate; ship first pass of KV-cache instrumentation.

Key metrics (target = end of Q2):
- p99 latency (small-chat): baseline 220ms -> target <= 150ms
- cache hit rate (top 10 prefixes): baseline 12% -> target 30%
- infra cost per 1k tokens: baseline $1.08 -> target <= $0.85
- rollout readiness: 0/3 canary checks automated -> target 3/3

This week status (quick):
- p99: 210ms (w/ new kernel selection branch on a subset) — improvement but regression with long-context tests (investigating).
- cache hit rate: 14% (after small config change) — need better instrumentation to know distribution.
- KV cache instrumentation PR open (gh#412) — awaiting review from Ethan.
- Canary checks: added smoke test for memory leak but flaky on GPU-driver nodes.

Blockers / questions:
- flaky smoke tests: is this infra instability (driver) or test timing? Need SRE help. (tag Samira).
- kernel selection regression on long-context: repro steps only on prod-like data; might need synthetic test harness.
- measurement gap: prefix distribution aggregate is hiding top-k long tails — want per-model per-route breakdown.

Draft OKRs (bring to 1:1 for wording):
O1: Deliver reliable low-latency serving for small-chat workloads
KR1.1: Reduce p99 latency from 220ms -> <=150ms for small-chat under 95th percentile load
KR1.2: Automate 3 canary/rollback checks for serving runtime
KR1.3: Decrease infra cost per 1k tokens by 20% via batching + quantization recommendations

O2: Improve cache effectiveness and observability
KR2.1: Increase prefix KV cache hit rate for top 10 prefixes from 12% -> 30%
KR2.2: Ship per-route cache telemetry and dashboard (Console)

Action items (next 7 days):
- finish unit+integration tests for gh#412 (me) — target Tue EOD
- pair with SRE on smoke-test flakiness (book session Wed) — @Samira
- create synthetic long-context harness and run kernel selection perf matrix (pair with Ethan) — target Thu
- quick dashboard mock for per-route cache telemetry (prototype in console) — start Fri

Notes to self / talking points for 1:1:
- need clarity on how aggressive we can be on quantization recommendations for hosted customers (compliance risk?).
- ask about prioritization tradeoff between caching improvements vs kernel-level optimizations (which yields better unit-economic impact?).
- request 2 days of focused dev time next sprint to stabilize smoke tests and finish instrumentation.

Random ideas / backlog (not prioritized):
- experiment: adaptive batching policy by customer tier (could reduce cost for multi-tenant)
- eval: run small-chat workloads across model variants to measure served latency variance

Open questions for collaborators:
- Samira: can SRE allocate 1-2 hours this week to help repro stability?
- Ethan: any updates on review cadence for gh#412? If blocked, can we split smaller PRs?

TODO (quick):
- [ ] push smaller PR to unblock review
- [ ] add more travis-type artifacts for flakiness repro
- [ ] draft OKR email to manager with proposed wording

Status snapshot: draft — feel-good about p99 improvements, but measurement gaps + flaky tests are main risk. Bring concrete asks to 1:1.
